segments.text: THou arte my porcyon, O Lorde: I haue promiſed to kepe thy lawe.
I made mine humble peticion in thy preſence with my whole heart: O be mercifull vnto me, accordyng vnto thy woorde.
I cal mine owne waies to remembraunce: and turne my feete into thy teſtimonies.
I made haſte: and prolonged not the tyme to keepe thy commaundementes.
The congregacions of the vngodly haue robbed me: but I haue not forgotten thy lawe.
At midnight will I ryſe, to geue thankes vnto thee: becauſe of thy righteous iudgementes.
I am a companyon of all them that feare thee: and kepe thy commaundementes.
The earth, O Lorde, is full of thy mercie: O teache me thy ſtatutes.
Glory be to the father, and to the ſonne: & to the holy goſt.
As it was in the begynnyng, is nowe, and euer ſhalbe: world without ende. Amen.
